written: 2026-10-13, after verification v2 (call 2 wrapped its action in a JSON list) and before any v3 generation
approved_by: user, chat 2026-10-13: GO glmlow-v3: strict singleton-list normalization, verified on the saved responses, then the bounded five-problem pilot; temperature unchanged; no repeated verification loops

generator.why: a weaker setting of the endpoint that worked (GLM-5.3 answered 25 of 25 streamed requests in the GLM-max pilot): reasoning_effort low (accepted by this endpoint on 2026-10-11, tools/judge_qual_v1.py 'glm'), temperature 1.0 for more variety between the 5 samples, top_p 1.0; fixed before the first call

verification: OFFLINE: the saved responses of verification v2 (and v1 call 2) re-decoded with the normalization must all decode; no new API verification calls. Transport failures (no HTTP 200) are retried by the generation loop; format failures are INVALID samples and never stop the pilot
problem_choice: the 5 problems registered for the stopped gpt-oss-20b pilot (positions 6-10 of the hash order); none was ever sent to a model
call_logic: judge_qual_v1.run_jobs: <= 5 in flight per key, <= 39 sends per key per minute, a rate-limit response cools that key 60 s and re-queues; a sample with no HTTP 200 gets a new attempt id (hard stop 20); a 200 answer is final; all 25 raw responses kept
execution: tools/val_outcome_glm_v1.py execute <pilot> a3 (amendments 2 and 3 from the start; baseline must reproduce the recorded failure twice)
features: local GPU capture with tools/val_capture_local.py (same representation as the Kaggle capture); used ONLY after its parity gate passes against the Kaggle capture of the GLM pilot pools (every hq / ho cosine >= 0.999 and identical top choices); otherwise scoring stops
selectors: laya_v4 (rebuilt coding head x3), random_head_v4 (rebuilt x9), laya_baseline_v1 (x3), linear_probe (refit on the 303 TRAIN pools), first valid candidate, random among valid; raw sample 1 reported separately. End-to-end (invalid = fail) and valid-only reported apart
expansion_gate: continue to the remaining 13 VAL problems only if at least 2 of the 5 problems have >= 1 PASS and >= 1 FAIL among valid candidates; otherwise stop. Generator and threshold are not changed after seeing results
aim: more pools with BOTH passing and failing valid candidates; all candidates of a pool share one author and one setting
limit: a positive selector result shows separation of passing from failing fixes among real model errors; it does not show help for a small local model
monitoring: every send's start, end, key, latency and HTTP status are reconstructed from the ledger, with the number of requests in flight on that key at its start, so a recurrence of 504s during generation can be tied to concurrency or not
normalization: answer text that parses as a JSON list of EXACTLY one object whose keys are EXACTLY {reply, calls} is replaced by that object; anything else is passed unchanged to the unchanged v3t decoder (which validates schema and tool safety). The raw text is kept next to the normalized text. Applies to v3 only
